scope: Object-anchored translucent narration for existing ReadableProp posters; Unity presentation only

presentation.placement: World-space plane beside the source renderer, with viewport-aware side selection
presentation.appearance: Translucent ivory text, softened glyph edges, feathered shadow, perspective, fade in/out
presentation.depthBoundary: Spatial perspective and softened text; no room-wide depth-of-field pass
presentation.compositing: Dedicated layer 31 and disabled render camera, composited after the room retro effect
presentation.controls: Left click to read; left click/Space/Enter to advance; Escape to dismiss
presentation.pagination: Measured text capacity; newline paragraphs; balanced short paragraphs
presentation.lifecycle: Pause retains the page; restore, disabled source/host and gameplay transitions cancel reading

limits: Target-platform build and full game walkthrough not run
